lines: Shipping & Delivery Policy
Effective Date: 9 November 2026

At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we are committed to providing a straightforward, transparent, and reliable delivery experience for our customers throughout the United Kingdom.
This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains our shipping locations, delivery charges, order processing times, estimated delivery schedules, and procedures for delayed, damaged, or missing shipments.
1. Business Information
Store Name: The Handle Factory
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Customer Support Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Time Zone: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), London
2. Shipping Locations
We currently offer shipping to eligible delivery addresses throughout the United Kingdom.
All orders are delivered directly to the customer's designated delivery address.
Please ensure that your delivery address, postcode, and contact information are accurate when placing your order.
We do not currently advertise international shipping outside the United Kingdom.
3. Free Shipping on All Orders
We offer FREE standard shipping on all orders within the United Kingdom.
* Shipping Cost: £0.00
* Minimum Order Value: None
* Maximum Order Value: No restriction for standard free shipping
* Shipping Method: Standard delivery
* Delivery Destination: Customer's address
There are no standard shipping charges, regardless of the total order value.
Any optional services or charges, if applicable, will be clearly disclosed before checkout.
4. Order Cut-Off Time
Our daily order cut-off time is:
12:00 AM (Midnight) GMT — London Time
Orders are processed on business days, Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.
Orders placed after the applicable cut-off are counted from the next eligible business-day processing cycle.
Orders placed on weekends or public holidays enter the next available business-day processing cycle.
5. Order Processing & Handling Time
Our standard order handling time is:
3 Business Days
* Minimum Handling Time: 3 business days
* Maximum Handling Time: 3 business days
* Processing Days: Monday to Friday
* Weekends: Excluded
* Public Holidays: Excluded
During this period, orders are prepared, checked, packaged, and made ready for dispatch.
Order handling time does not include the time required by the delivery carrier to transport the shipment.
6. Shipping Transit Time
Once an order has been dispatched, the estimated shipping transit time is:
2–4 Business Days
* Minimum Transit Time: 2 business days
* Maximum Transit Time: 4 business days
* Shipping Days: Monday to Friday
* Delivery Region: United Kingdom
Transit times may vary due to carrier operations, adverse weather, public holidays, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
7. Estimated Total Delivery Time
Our estimated total delivery timeframe is:
5–7 Business Days
Delivery Stage
Estimated Time
Order Processing & Handling
3 business days
Shipping Transit
2–4 business days
Total Estimated Delivery
5–7 business days
Important: Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.
Delivery estimates begin from the applicable order processing cycle and are not guaranteed arrival dates.
If an order is expected to take longer than the stated timeframe, we will provide updated information when available.
Your statutory delivery rights remain unaffected by these estimates.
8. Order Confirmation
After successfully placing an order, you will receive an order confirmation at the email address provided during checkout.
Your confirmation will contain relevant order details, such as:
* Order number
* Purchased products
* Order total in GBP (£)
* Billing and delivery information
* Selected shipping method
Please review the confirmation and contact us promptly if any details are incorrect.
9. Shipping Confirmation & Tracking
When your order has been dispatched, we will provide a shipping confirmation with tracking information where available.
Tracking details may include:
* Carrier name
* Tracking number
* Tracking link
* Shipment status
* Estimated delivery information
You can monitor your order through our Track Your Order page or by using the tracking link provided.
If you need help locating your shipment, please contact info@thehandlefactory.uk.
10. Delivery of Large or Heavy Products

Some of our products, including fireplaces, generators, water heaters, saunas, furnaces, and boilers, may require additional delivery arrangements due to their dimensions, weight, or handling requirements.
Where special arrangements are necessary, we will communicate the relevant delivery instructions.
Customers should ensure that the delivery location is reasonably accessible and suitable for receiving the ordered product.
Unless explicitly stated in the product listing or agreed separately, standard delivery does not include installation, assembly, or removal of existing equipment.
Any delivery restrictions or additional services must be disclosed before the customer completes their purchase.
11. Incorrect or Incomplete Delivery Addresses
Customers are responsible for providing accurate delivery information during checkout.
If you discover an error in your delivery address, please contact us immediately at info@thehandlefactory.uk.
We will attempt to update the address before dispatch where possible.
Once an order has been handed to the carrier, address changes may not be possible.
If an incorrect address results in a failed delivery, please contact our support team to discuss the available options.
12. Delayed Deliveries
Although we aim to deliver orders within 5–7 business days, unexpected circumstances may occasionally cause delays.
Possible causes include:
* Carrier disruptions
* Severe weather conditions
* Public holidays
* Transport interruptions
* Unexpected logistical issues
If your order is delayed, please contact our customer support team with your order number.
We will investigate the shipment and provide available updates.

Under applicable UK consumer law, goods must generally be delivered without undue delay and within 30 days unless a different delivery period has been agreed. Your statutory rights regarding late delivery remain unaffected.
13. Lost or Missing Packages
If tracking indicates that your package has been delivered but you have not received it, please contact us.
To help investigate, provide:
* Your order number
* Your full name
* Your delivery address
* Any relevant tracking information
We will review the delivery status and liaise with the carrier where appropriate.
Where goods have not been delivered to you or a person you authorised to receive them, we will provide an appropriate resolution in accordance with applicable UK consumer law.
14. Damaged Products Upon Delivery
If your order arrives damaged, please contact us as soon as reasonably possible.
Email info@thehandlefactory.uk with:
* Your order number
* The product name
* A description of the damage
* Photographs of the product or packaging, if available
Our team will review the issue and advise you on the next steps.
Depending on the circumstances and your statutory rights, an appropriate remedy may include a replacement, repair, or refund.
Reporting damage promptly helps us investigate carrier-related issues, but does not limit your statutory consumer rights.
15. Multiple Items & Split Shipments
If your order contains multiple products, they may occasionally be dispatched in separate packages.
Where this occurs, tracking information may be provided for each shipment.
Split shipments do not result in additional standard shipping charges.
If part of your order is missing, please contact us so we can investigate.
16. Failed Delivery Attempts
If a delivery cannot be completed because the recipient is unavailable, the carrier may provide instructions for redelivery or another suitable arrangement.
Please follow any legitimate delivery notifications provided by the carrier.
If you experience difficulties arranging delivery, contact our customer support team.
Any additional charges or arrangements will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the terms disclosed at checkout.
17. Order Cancellation Before Dispatch
If you wish to cancel an order before it has been dispatched, please contact us promptly.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Include your order number and cancellation request.
We will review the order status and assist with cancellation.
If the order has already been dispatched, your applicable statutory cancellation rights and our Returns & Refunds Policy will continue to apply.
18. Returns & Refunds
We offer a 30-day return window for eligible products.
Our standard returns arrangements include:
* Returns accepted for defective and non-defective products
* Exchanges accepted
* Standard non-defective returns for products in new condition
* Returns by post
* Free prepaid return label included in the package
* No restocking fees
* Refund processing within 10 days, subject to applicable statutory requirements
For complete details, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
19. Customer Support
If you have questions about shipping, order processing, tracking, or delivery, please contact us.
The Handle Factory
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
When contacting us about an existing order, please include your order number to help us locate the relevant information.
20. Changes to This Shipping Policy
We may update this Shipping & Delivery Policy to reflect operational changes, delivery arrangements, or applicable legal requirements.
Any updates will be published on this page with a revised effective date.
Changes will not retrospectively remove rights or contractual commitments applicable to orders already placed.
The Handle Factory — Shipping & Delivery Policy
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Last Updated: 9 November 2026

We offer a 30-day return policy, free return shipping, and exchanges for eligible products. This policy explains how to request a return, exchange, or refund, including the applicable conditions and processing times.

lines: Returns & Refunds Policy
Effective Date: 9 November 2026
Last Updated: 9 November 2026

At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we want our customers to shop with confidence. We understand that sometimes a product may not meet your expectations or may arrive damaged or defective.

We offer a 30-day return policy, free return shipping, and exchanges for eligible products. This policy explains how to request a return, exchange, or refund, including the applicable conditions and processing times.
1. Business Information
Store Name: The Handle Factory
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Customer Support Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
2. Our 30-Day Return Policy
We accept eligible returns within 30 calendar days from the date your order is delivered.
Our return policy covers:
* Products returned because you have changed your mind
* Products that do not meet your expectations
* Products received in error
* Damaged products
* Defective or faulty products
* Products that are not as described
Both defective and non-defective products are eligible for returns, subject to the conditions below and applicable UK consumer law.
To request a return, please contact us within the applicable return period.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Please include your order number and the reason for your return.
Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected by this voluntary 30-day return policy.
3. Return Eligibility & Product Condition
For standard returns of non-defective products, the following conditions apply:
* The return must be requested within 30 calendar days of delivery.
* The product must be in new condition.
* The product should be unused and uninstalled.
* All supplied accessories, manuals, and components should be included.
* The original packaging should be retained and used where reasonably possible.
* Proof of purchase or an order number must be provided.
These conditions apply to our voluntary return policy and do not override statutory cancellation rights or remedies for faulty, damaged, or misdescribed goods.

Where UK consumer law permits you to inspect goods, opening packaging or handling a product to establish its nature, characteristics, or functioning does not automatically remove your statutory cancellation rights.
However, deductions may be permitted where handling exceeds what is reasonably necessary, as provided by law.
4. How to Return a Product
We aim to make our returns process straightforward.
Step 1: Contact Customer Support
Email info@thehandlefactory.uk with the following details:
* Full name
* Order number
* Email address used at checkout
* Product name
* Reason for return
* Photographs, if relevant to a damage or defect claim
Step 2: Receive Return Instructions
Our customer support team will review your request and provide the appropriate return instructions.
Step 3: Prepare Your Return
Securely package the product, including all relevant accessories and components.
Use the free prepaid return label included in your package.
Step 4: Send the Product by Post
Return the product using the designated postal or courier service specified in the return instructions.
Please retain proof of postage and any tracking details.
Step 5: Refund or Exchange
Once the return has been received and assessed where appropriate, we will process the applicable refund or exchange.
5. Return Method
Our standard return method is:
By Post (Mail Return)
Customers should follow the return instructions provided by our support team.
Please do not send products to our registered business address unless our team has specifically confirmed that it is the correct return destination.
Some large or heavy products may require an arranged courier collection rather than a standard parcel drop-off.
Contact us before returning heavy equipment so that suitable transport arrangements can be confirmed.
6. Free Return Shipping
We provide FREE return shipping for eligible returns within the United Kingdom.
Our standard return arrangements are:
* Return Method: By post
* Return Label: Prepaid return label included in the package
* Return Label Cost: £0.00
* Standard Return Shipping Fee: £0.00
* Restocking Fee: £0.00
If your prepaid return label is missing, damaged, or unsuitable for your product, please contact us at info@thehandlefactory.uk.
We will provide an appropriate return shipping arrangement at no additional standard return shipping cost.
7. No Restocking Fees
We do not charge restocking fees.
Customers are not required to pay a restocking fee when returning an eligible product.
This applies to both defective and non-defective returns.
Any lawful deduction for excessive handling under statutory cancellation rules is separate from a restocking fee and will only be applied where permitted by law.
8. Refund Processing Time
Our standard refund processing timeframe is:
Within 10 days
Once your returned product has been received, we aim to assess the return and process any refund due within 10 calendar days.
Refunds will generally be issued to the original payment method used during checkout.
The time required for the refunded amount to appear in your account may vary depending on your bank or payment provider.

For statutory cancellations, we will comply with the applicable UK refund deadlines, including the requirement to refund within 14 days of receiving the returned goods or receiving evidence that they have been sent back, where applicable.
Where goods have not yet been delivered, different statutory refund timing rules may apply.
We will not delay a statutory refund beyond the period permitted by law.
9. Refund Amount
For an eligible return, the refund will generally include the amount paid for the returned product.
As we offer free standard shipping throughout the United Kingdom, there is normally no standard outbound shipping charge to refund.
Where required by applicable law, any qualifying original delivery charges will also be refunded.
Refunds may be adjusted only where permitted by law, including for any legally allowable reduction in value resulting from excessive handling.
We do not impose administrative or restocking fees for eligible returns.
10. Returns for Non-Defective Products
If you change your mind or decide that a product is not suitable for your needs, you may request a return within 30 calendar days of delivery.
Under our voluntary return policy, the product should be:
* In new condition
* Unused
* Uninstalled
* Complete with supplied accessories and components
Return shipping is free, and no restocking fee applies.
Your statutory cancellation rights remain available independently of these voluntary conditions.
11. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Products
If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product, please contact us promptly.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Include your order number, a description of the problem, and photographs where available.
We will investigate the issue and provide an appropriate remedy.
Depending on the circumstances and your statutory rights, remedies may include:
* Repair
* Replacement
* Exchange
* Full or partial refund
We will cover reasonable return costs where required by law, and our standard return shipping arrangements are free.

Important: Under the UK Consumer Rights Act 2015, consumers generally have a 30-day short-term right to reject faulty goods for a refund, subject to statutory conditions. Additional rights to repair, replacement, price reduction, or rejection may apply beyond that period.
Our voluntary 30-day return window does not limit those rights.
12. Exchanges
We accept exchanges for eligible products.
You may request an exchange if:
* You received an incorrect product.
* Your product is damaged or defective.
* You wish to exchange an eligible product for another available item.
To request an exchange, contact info@thehandlefactory.uk with your order number and the details of the requested replacement.
Exchanges are subject to the availability of the requested product.
If the replacement product is unavailable, we will discuss alternative options, including a refund where applicable.
No standard return shipping or restocking fees apply to eligible exchanges.
Any difference in product price will be communicated before an exchange is completed.
13. UK Consumer Cancellation Rights

Under the Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013, consumers purchasing most goods online generally have a statutory right to cancel within 14 days after receiving the goods, subject to applicable exceptions.
To exercise this right, you must clearly inform us of your decision to cancel within the statutory cancellation period.
You may contact us by email:
info@thehandlefactory.uk
After notifying us of cancellation, you generally have a further 14 days to send the goods back.
We provide free return shipping under our stated returns arrangements.
Where applicable, refunds will be made in accordance with statutory requirements.
Our voluntary 30-day return policy provides additional return options and does not replace or restrict statutory cancellation rights.
14. Returns for Large or Heavy Products
Certain products sold by The Handle Factory may be large, heavy, or require specialist handling.
These may include:
* Fireplaces
* Generators
* Water Heaters
* Saunas
* Furnaces & Boilers
If you wish to return a large or heavy product, please contact our support team before arranging transportation.
We will provide appropriate instructions and help arrange a suitable return method.
Eligible returns remain subject to our free return shipping policy.
Please do not attempt to dismantle, disconnect, or transport equipment in an unsafe manner.
Gas, electrical, and other safety-critical installations should only be disconnected by appropriately qualified professionals where required.
Any installation or removal services are separate from our standard product return arrangements unless otherwise agreed or required by law.
15. Products That Have Been Installed or Used
Under our voluntary 30-day return policy, non-defective products must generally be returned in new, unused, and uninstalled condition.
If a product has been installed or used, please contact our customer support team before returning it.
Statutory rights may still apply, including where:
* The product is faulty.
* The product is not as described.
* The product does not meet applicable quality requirements.
* The customer has a statutory cancellation right.
We will assess each request in accordance with applicable UK consumer law.
16. Missing Accessories or Components
If your order arrives with missing accessories or components, please contact us.
Provide your order number and details of the missing items.
We will review the issue and arrange an appropriate resolution.
If you are returning a product under our voluntary return policy, please include all supplied accessories and components where possible.
Your statutory rights will not be denied solely because original packaging is unavailable.
17. Refunds for Cancelled Orders
If your order is cancelled before dispatch, we will process the refund in accordance with the applicable cancellation terms and statutory requirements.
Refunds are generally issued to the original payment method.
If the order has already been dispatched, you may still exercise applicable statutory cancellation rights or request a return under our 30-day policy.
For more information, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
18. Late or Missing Refunds
If you have not received your refund after being notified that it has been processed:
1. Check the account associated with your original payment method.
2. Contact your bank or payment provider to confirm whether the refund is pending.
3. If you still cannot locate the refund, contact info@thehandlefactory.uk.
Please provide your order number and any relevant refund confirmation details.
Our team will investigate the issue.
19. Return Requests Outside the 30-Day Window
Our voluntary return window is 30 calendar days from delivery.

If you wish to return a non-defective product after this period, please contact us to discuss your circumstances. We are not obliged to accept a voluntary change-of-mind return outside the stated window.
However, statutory rights relating to faulty, damaged, misdescribed, or non-conforming goods may continue beyond 30 days.
Nothing in this policy excludes or limits rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under UK consumer protection legislation.
20. Contact Us for Returns & Refunds
If you have questions about returns, exchanges, refunds, or product issues, please contact our customer support team.
The Handle Factory
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Please contact us before posting any return so we can confirm the appropriate return destination and instructions.
21. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Returns & Refunds Policy to reflect changes in our business operations, customer service procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
Any revisions will be published on this page with an updated effective date.
Changes will not retrospectively remove rights or contractual commitments applicable to purchases already made.
The Handle Factory — Returns & Refunds Policy
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Last Updated: 9 November 2026

lines: Order Cancellation Policy
Effective Date: 9 November 2026
Last Updated: 9 November 2026

At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we understand that customers may occasionally need to cancel an order due to changes in their requirements, incorrect order details, or other circumstances.
This Order Cancellation Policy explains how to request a cancellation, the cancellation process, refund arrangements, and your rights under applicable United Kingdom consumer protection laws.
1. Business Information
Store Name: The Handle Factory
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Customer Support Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
2. Cancelling an Order Before Dispatch
Customers may request cancellation of an order at any time before it has been dispatched.
To request cancellation, please contact our customer support team as soon as possible.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Please include:
* Your full name
* Order number
* Email address used during checkout
* Product name
* Reason for cancellation (optional)
Our team will review your order status and confirm the cancellation arrangements.
If your order has not yet been dispatched, we will aim to stop fulfilment and arrange a refund.
There is no order cancellation fee.
3. Order Processing & Cancellation Timing
Our standard order handling time is 3 business days, Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.
Our order cut-off time is 12:00 AM (midnight), GMT.
Customers are encouraged to submit cancellation requests as soon as they decide not to proceed with their purchase.
Although we aim to accommodate cancellation requests before dispatch, an order may already be undergoing fulfilment when we receive your request.
The inability to stop dispatch does not remove any applicable statutory cancellation rights.
4. Cancelling an Order After Dispatch
If your order has already been dispatched, please contact us immediately.
Depending on the shipment status, we may be able to request a delivery interception or provide return instructions.
If the delivery cannot be stopped, you can generally exercise your applicable statutory cancellation rights after receiving the goods, subject to any lawful exceptions.
You may also request a return under our voluntary 30-day Returns & Refunds Policy.
Standard return shipping is free, and we do not charge restocking fees.
Please contact info@thehandlefactory.uk for assistance.
5. Your Statutory Right to Cancel

Under the UK's Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013, consumers purchasing most goods online generally have the right to cancel their order without giving a reason.
For eligible goods, the statutory cancellation period normally begins when the contract is made and expires 14 calendar days after the day the goods are received.
If an order is delivered in multiple instalments, the period generally runs from receipt of the final instalment.
Certain products or contracts may be subject to statutory exceptions.
To exercise your cancellation right, you must clearly inform us of your decision before the applicable cancellation period expires.
You may do this by emailing:
info@thehandlefactory.uk
You do not need to provide a reason when exercising your statutory right to cancel.
6. How to Submit a Cancellation Request
To cancel an order, follow these steps.
Step 1: Contact Us
Send an email to info@thehandlefactory.uk with the subject:
Order Cancellation Request – [Your Order Number]
Step 2: Provide Your Order Details
Include your name, order number, and a clear statement that you wish to cancel your order.
Step 3: Receive Confirmation
Our customer support team will review your request and provide confirmation or further instructions.
Step 4: Return the Product if Required
If the product has already been delivered, follow the return instructions provided.
Step 5: Receive Your Refund
We will process any refund due in accordance with this policy and applicable UK consumer law.
7. Cancellation Fees
We do not charge cancellation fees for eligible order cancellations.
Our cancellation arrangements include:
* Cancellation Fee: £0.00
* Restocking Fee: £0.00
* Standard Return Shipping Fee: £0.00
There are no administrative cancellation charges.
Any lawful deduction for excessive handling of returned goods, where permitted by consumer law, is separate from a cancellation or restocking fee.
8. Refunds for Cancelled Orders
If your order is cancelled before dispatch, we will arrange a refund to the original payment method.
Our standard refund processing target is within 10 calendar days, subject to applicable statutory deadlines.
For cancellations under the Consumer Contracts Regulations:
* Where goods have not been delivered, refunds must generally be made within 14 days of being informed of the cancellation.
* Where goods have been delivered, we may generally wait until the goods are returned or evidence of their return is provided before issuing the refund, where the law permits.
* The applicable statutory refund deadline will be observed.
Refunds will normally be issued using the original payment method unless you expressly agree otherwise.
We will not impose refund processing fees.
Your bank or payment provider may require additional time to display the refunded amount.
9. Refund Amount for Cancelled Orders
For an eligible full cancellation, we will refund the amounts required by applicable law.
This generally includes:
* The price paid for the cancelled goods
* Any qualifying original standard delivery charges
As The Handle Factory offers free standard UK shipping, there is normally no standard shipping charge to refund.
Where permitted by law, a deduction may apply for a reduction in the value of goods caused by handling beyond what is necessary to establish their nature, characteristics, and functioning.
We do not charge restocking fees.
10. Cancelling Part of an Order
If your order contains multiple products and you wish to cancel only certain items, please contact us as soon as possible.
Include the order number and identify the products you wish to cancel.
If the affected items have not been dispatched, we will aim to cancel them and refund the relevant amount.
If they have already been dispatched, the applicable return and statutory cancellation arrangements will apply.
Any refund will be calculated based on the items cancelled and applicable legal requirements.
11. Incorrect Order Details
If you entered an incorrect delivery address, selected the wrong product, or made another ordering mistake, contact us immediately.
We will attempt to assist with corrections before dispatch.
If the order cannot be amended, cancellation and replacement ordering may be necessary.
Once a shipment has been dispatched, changes may be limited by the carrier's procedures.
Your statutory cancellation rights remain unaffected.
12. Cancellation of Large or Heavy Products
Some products sold by The Handle Factory require special delivery or handling arrangements.
These include:
* Fireplaces
* Generators
* Water Heaters
* Saunas
* Furnaces & Boilers
If you wish to cancel an order containing a large or heavy product, please contact us promptly.
Where a product has already been delivered, we will provide suitable return instructions and arrange an appropriate return method where necessary.
Our stated free return shipping arrangements apply to eligible returns.
For safety reasons, equipment connected to gas, electrical, or heating systems should only be disconnected by appropriately qualified professionals where required.
Any installation or removal services are separate from the standard return of goods unless otherwise agreed or required by law.
13. Cancellation Due to Damaged or Defective Products
If you receive a product that is damaged, faulty, or not as described, please contact our support team.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Provide your order number and a description of the issue.
Depending on the circumstances, you may be entitled to:
* Repair
* Replacement
* Price reduction
* Refund
* Rejection of the goods
Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, consumers generally have a short-term right to reject faulty goods within 30 days, subject to statutory conditions.
Additional remedies may remain available beyond that period.
Our cancellation and returns policies do not restrict these rights.
14. Cancellation Due to Delivery Delays
Our standard estimated delivery timeframe is 5–7 business days, consisting of:
* Order Handling: 3 business days
* Transit Time: 2–4 business days
If delivery is delayed, please contact us for an update.
Under UK consumer law, goods must generally be delivered without undue delay and within 30 days unless another delivery period has been agreed.

Where applicable, customers may be entitled to cancel because of late delivery, including where an agreed essential delivery deadline has been missed or a legally required additional delivery period has expired.
We will handle such requests in accordance with applicable statutory requirements.
15. Orders Cancelled by The Handle Factory
In certain circumstances, we may be unable to fulfil an order.
Possible reasons include:
* Product unavailability
* Payment authorisation failure
* Incorrect pricing or product information, where cancellation is legally permitted
* Delivery restrictions identified before fulfilment
* Suspected fraudulent transactions requiring verification
* Other circumstances that prevent lawful fulfilment
If we are unable to fulfil an order, we will notify you and explain the available options.
Where cancellation is appropriate, we will issue any refund due in accordance with applicable law.
We will not retain payment for goods that we cannot supply where a refund is legally required.
16. Returns Following Cancellation
If you have already received your order and wish to cancel, you may need to return the goods.
For statutory cancellations, goods must generally be sent back within 14 days after notifying us of cancellation, unless we agree to collect them.
Under our voluntary return policy, eligible products may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery.
Our standard return arrangements include:
* Free prepaid return label included in the package
* Returns by post or an appropriate arranged carrier
* No restocking fees
* Exchanges accepted
* Refund processing target of 10 days, subject to statutory requirements
Please review our Returns & Refunds Policy for further details.
17. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Order Cancellation Policy to reflect changes in our business operations, customer service procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
Any revisions will be published on this page with an updated effective date.
Changes will not retrospectively remove statutory rights or contractual commitments applicable to orders already placed.
18. Contact Us
If you need help cancelling an order or have questions about refunds, please contact us.
The Handle Factory
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk

At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we aim to provide a straightforward, secure, and convenient checkout experience.

1. Business Information

Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk

Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR

2. Accepted Payment Methods
The payment methods available for your purchase are displayed during checkout.
Depending on the payment services enabled on our website, these may include debit cards, credit cards, or other supported electronic payment options.
Only payment methods shown as available at checkout are accepted.
Please review the payment options before completing your order.
We do not require customers to send payment card details by email or telephone.
3. Payment Currency
All product prices and checkout totals are displayed in British Pounds Sterling (GBP, £).
Payments are charged in GBP.
If your bank account or payment card uses another currency, your bank or card provider may apply currency conversion rates or additional charges.
Any such charges are determined by your financial institution and are not controlled by The Handle Factory.
4. Secure Payment Processing
We aim to provide a secure checkout environment.
Payments are handled through the payment processing services enabled on our website.
Depending on the selected payment method, customers may be redirected to a secure payment page or asked to complete additional verification.
We do not ask customers to provide full payment card numbers, card security codes, or banking passwords through email.
Customers should only complete payments through the official checkout at:
https://thehandlefactory.uk
5. Payment Authorisation
When you place an order, your selected payment provider may perform an authorisation or verification check.
A transaction may be declined or require additional verification for reasons including:
* Incorrect payment details
* Insufficient available funds
* Bank security restrictions
* Failed authentication
* Payment provider limitations
* Suspected unauthorised activity
If your payment is declined, please check your details or contact your bank or payment provider.
You may also try another payment method displayed at checkout.
6. When Will I Be Charged?
The timing of a payment charge depends on the payment method and payment processor used during checkout.
The applicable amount will be displayed before you confirm your purchase.
Once payment is successfully completed, you should receive an order confirmation by email.
If you believe you have been charged without receiving an order confirmation, please contact our customer support team before attempting another payment.
7. Pricing & Additional Charges
We aim to display product prices and applicable charges clearly before an order is submitted.
Currency: GBP (£)
Standard UK Shipping: Free (£0.00)
Minimum Order Value for Free Shipping: None
Any applicable taxes or additional charges will be displayed in accordance with legal requirements.
We do not charge an additional fee solely for using a consumer debit or credit card where such a surcharge is prohibited by UK law.
Your bank or payment provider may impose separate charges under its own terms.
8. Payment Confirmation
After a successful purchase, you should receive an order confirmation email containing relevant details, including:
* Order number
* Purchased products
* Total amount paid
* Billing information
* Delivery information
* Order status
Please retain your confirmation for future reference.
If you do not receive it, check your spam or junk folder and contact info@thehandlefactory.uk if assistance is needed.
9. Failed or Declined Payments
If a payment fails, please do not repeatedly submit the same transaction without checking whether a payment has already been authorised.
You can:
1. Confirm that your payment details are correct.
2. Check your available balance or credit limit.
3. Complete any authentication requested by your bank.
4. Contact your payment provider.
5. Try another available checkout method.
If the problem continues, email info@thehandlefactory.uk.
Never send full payment card details or security codes to our support team.
10. Duplicate or Unrecognised Charges
If you believe you have been charged more than once or notice an unexpected transaction associated with your order, please contact us.
Provide:
* Your order number, if available
* The date of the transaction
* The amount charged
* A brief description of the issue
Do not provide your full card number, security code, or online banking credentials.
We will review the available order and payment records and advise you on the appropriate next steps.
For suspected unauthorised transactions, you should also contact your bank or card issuer promptly.
11. Refunds & Payment Reversals
Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method used for the purchase.
Our standard refund processing target is within 10 calendar days, subject to applicable UK statutory refund deadlines.
Once a refund has been issued, the time required for the funds to appear in your account may depend on your bank or payment provider.
We do not charge restocking fees for eligible returns.
For complete information, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
12. Order Cancellation & Refunds
If you wish to cancel an order, please contact us promptly.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Include your order number and a clear cancellation request.
If your order has not yet been dispatched, we will aim to stop fulfilment and process any refund due.
If the order has already been dispatched, applicable cancellation and return rights may still apply.
For further information, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
13. Payment Security & Fraud Prevention
To protect customers and reduce unauthorised transactions, payment processors may conduct security checks.
In some circumstances, an order may require additional verification before fulfilment.
We may contact customers to clarify order information where reasonably necessary.
We will never ask you to disclose your payment card security code, online banking password, or one-time authentication code by email or telephone.
If you receive a suspicious payment request claiming to be from The Handle Factory, please contact us through our official website.
14. Customer Privacy
Payment-related personal information is handled in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.
Information may be shared with payment processors and other relevant service providers where necessary to complete transactions, prevent fraud, process refunds, or comply with legal obligations.
For more information, please review our Privacy Policy.
15. Payment Support
If you experience a payment issue or have a question about a transaction, please contact us.
The Handle Factory
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Please include your order number and a brief description of your enquiry.
16. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Payment Methods Policy to reflect changes in available payment services, checkout procedures, or applicable legal requirements.
Updates will be published on this page with a revised effective date.
Changes will not retrospectively remove statutory rights or contractual commitments applicable to completed purchases.

intro: At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we understand that purchasing home heating equipment, generators, fireplaces, saunas, and other household products is an important investment.
We are committed to helping customers understand their product warranties, obtain appropriate after-sales assistance, and resolve issues involving faulty, damaged, or incorrectly supplied goods.

lines: Warranty & Product Support
Effective Date: 9 November 2026
Last Updated: 9 November 2026

At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we understand that purchasing home heating equipment, generators, fireplaces, saunas, and other household products is an important investment.
We are committed to helping customers understand their product warranties, obtain appropriate after-sales assistance, and resolve issues involving faulty, damaged, or incorrectly supplied goods.
This Warranty & Product Support Policy explains how warranty coverage works, how to request assistance, and your rights under applicable United Kingdom consumer protection laws.
1. Business Information
Store Name: The Handle Factory
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Customer Support Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
2. Our Warranty Commitment
We aim to provide customers with clear information about the warranty coverage applicable to their purchases.
Products may be supplied with a manufacturer's warranty or another commercial warranty, depending on the brand, product model, and terms provided with the item.
Warranty coverage and duration vary by product.
Where a commercial warranty applies, the relevant details may be found in the product description, manufacturer's documentation, or warranty information supplied with the product.
We do not represent that every product carries an identical commercial warranty period.
Importantly, any commercial warranty is additional to your statutory consumer rights and does not replace or restrict them.
3. Your Rights Under UK Consumer Law
Customers purchasing goods as consumers are protected by the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
Goods must generally be:
* Of satisfactory quality
* Fit for their intended purpose
* As described
* Consistent with applicable contractual requirements
If a product fails to meet these requirements, you may be entitled to a legal remedy.
Depending on the circumstances, these remedies may include:
* A refund
* Repair
* Replacement
* Price reduction
* Final rejection of the goods
The First 30 Days
Consumers generally have a short-term right to reject faulty or non-conforming goods within 30 days, subject to the statutory conditions and exceptions.
Where this right applies, you may be entitled to a refund.
After the First 30 Days
If a fault becomes apparent after the initial 30-day period, you may still have the right to request a repair or replacement.
If a repair or replacement is unsuccessful, impossible, or cannot be provided within a reasonable time without significant inconvenience, further remedies may apply.
Faults Within the First Six Months

Where a fault becomes apparent within the first six months, UK consumer law generally presumes that the goods did not conform to the contract at delivery, unless the trader proves otherwise or the presumption is incompatible with the goods or the nature of the fault.
Rights Beyond Six Months
Statutory rights may continue beyond six months, depending on the circumstances, evidence, and applicable limitation periods.
In England and Wales, claims for breach of contract may generally be brought within six years, although this does not mean every product is guaranteed to last six years.
Your statutory rights are not limited by the duration of a manufacturer's warranty.
4. Manufacturer Warranty Coverage
Certain products may include commercial warranty coverage provided by their manufacturers.
Depending on the applicable warranty terms, coverage may relate to:
* Manufacturing defects
* Faulty materials
* Defects in workmanship
* Specified components
* Certain electrical or mechanical failures
The exact coverage, exclusions, duration, and claim procedures depend on the relevant manufacturer's terms.
Please review the documentation supplied with your product.
If you need assistance locating warranty information, contact our customer support team.
5. How to Request Warranty Support
If you experience an issue with a product purchased from The Handle Factory, please follow these steps.
Step 1: Contact Our Support Team
Email info@thehandlefactory.uk.
Step 2: Provide Your Purchase Details
Include:
* Full name
* Order number
* Product name
* Brand and model number
* Date of purchase or delivery
* Description of the issue
* Photographs or video, where available and safe to obtain
Step 3: Initial Review
Our team will review the information and advise you on the appropriate next steps.
We may request additional details where reasonably necessary to understand the issue.
Step 4: Assessment or Inspection
Depending on the product and reported fault, an inspection or technical assessment may be appropriate.
For installed or heavy equipment, we will discuss suitable arrangements before asking you to return or move the item.
Step 5: Resolution
Where a legal or commercial warranty remedy applies, we will assist with the appropriate resolution in accordance with the relevant terms and applicable law.
6. Product Support by Category
Wood Stove Accessories
For stove accessories, support may include enquiries relating to product defects, damaged components, missing parts, and compatibility information.
Please provide the relevant stove or accessory model where available.
Fireplaces
For fireplaces, we can assist with general product information, reported faults, and available warranty documentation.
Fireplaces must be installed and used in accordance with manufacturer instructions and applicable building and fire safety requirements.
Where installation requires a qualified professional, customers should use an appropriately competent installer.
Generators
For generators, support may involve reported manufacturing defects, electrical or mechanical issues, and manufacturer warranty enquiries.
Always follow the manufacturer's operating and maintenance instructions.
Fuel-burning generators must never be operated indoors, in garages, or in enclosed spaces due to the risk of fatal carbon monoxide poisoning.
If a generator develops an unsafe fault, stop using it and seek appropriate professional assistance.
Water Heaters
For water heaters, support may involve reported heating faults, leaks, damaged components, or product documentation.
Gas appliances must be installed and serviced by appropriately Gas Safe registered engineers where required.
Electrical work must comply with applicable safety requirements.
Saunas
For saunas, support may include enquiries relating to heaters, control systems, supplied components, and product defects.
Electrical installation and ventilation requirements must be followed carefully.
Do not operate a sauna if you suspect an electrical or overheating fault.
Furnaces & Boilers
For furnaces and boilers, support may involve reported component faults, product information, and warranty documentation.
Gas boilers must be installed and serviced by appropriately Gas Safe registered engineers.
Customers should retain installation and servicing records where relevant to a manufacturer's commercial warranty.
7. Professional Installation Requirements
Some products require professional installation to operate safely and comply with applicable regulations.
These may include:
* Gas boilers and water heaters
* Certain fireplaces and stoves
* Hardwired electrical heating equipment
* Sauna heaters and electrical systems
* Permanently connected power equipment
Customers should follow the manufacturer's installation instructions and use appropriately qualified professionals where required.
Incorrect installation may affect commercial warranty coverage where the applicable warranty lawfully provides for this.
However, a manufacturer's warranty exclusion does not automatically remove statutory rights against the retailer.
8. What May Not Be Covered by a Commercial Warranty?
Commercial warranty exclusions vary by product and manufacturer.
Depending on the applicable terms, exclusions may include:
* Accidental damage
* Misuse or abuse
* Unauthorised modifications
* Damage caused by unsuitable installation
* Failure to follow operating instructions
* Normal wear and tear
* Damage caused by external events
* Maintenance-related issues outside the stated warranty coverage
These are examples only and do not represent universal exclusions applicable to every product.
Commercial warranty exclusions cannot override statutory rights where goods are faulty, misdescribed, or otherwise fail to conform to the sales contract.
9. Repairs & Replacements
Where a repair or replacement is required under applicable consumer law, it must generally be provided:
* Within a reasonable time
* Without significant inconvenience to the consumer
* At no necessary cost to the consumer
This may include reasonable postage, labour, or material costs.
For products requiring removal or reinstallation, applicable statutory obligations will be considered.
Where a commercial warranty provides additional repair or replacement benefits, those benefits will be governed by the relevant warranty terms.
10. Large & Heavy Equipment Support
Some products, including boilers, generators, fireplaces, and saunas, may be too large or heavy for standard parcel returns.
If your product requires inspection, repair, replacement, or return, please contact our support team before arranging transportation.
We will advise on the appropriate process and any available collection or inspection arrangements.
Where a statutory remedy applies, we will meet our legal obligations regarding reasonable costs and inconvenience.
For safety reasons, do not disconnect gas appliances or other hazardous installations yourself.
11. Warranty Claims for Damaged or Defective Products
If a product arrives damaged or defective, please contact us as soon as reasonably possible.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Include your order number and details of the issue.
Photographs may help us investigate the problem, but they are not an absolute requirement for exercising statutory rights.
Depending on the circumstances, we may arrange a repair, replacement, refund, or another legally appropriate remedy.
Please do not continue using equipment that appears unsafe.
12. Returns & Refunds
In addition to statutory consumer rights, The Handle Factory offers a 30-day voluntary return policy for eligible purchases.
Our standard arrangements include:
* Returns for defective and non-defective products
* Exchanges accepted
* Free prepaid return shipping
* No restocking fees
* A standard refund processing target of 10 days
Non-defective products returned under the voluntary policy should generally be in new, unused, and uninstalled condition.
Different conditions apply where statutory cancellation rights or remedies for faulty goods are exercised.
For complete details, please review our Returns & Refunds Policy.
13. Proof of Purchase
When requesting warranty support, please provide your order number or another reasonable form of proof of purchase.
Acceptable evidence may include:
* Order confirmation email
* Receipt or invoice
* Relevant payment record
* Other information reasonably establishing the purchase
Original packaging is not necessarily required to exercise statutory rights.
14. Warranty Support for Replacement Products
If a product is repaired or replaced, the applicable warranty position will depend on the manufacturer's terms, the circumstances of the remedy, and statutory requirements.
A repair or replacement does not automatically eliminate or reduce any statutory rights that continue to apply.
Our team can assist with relevant warranty documentation where available.
15. Customer Responsibilities
To help maintain safe product operation and support an efficient claims process, customers should:
* Follow the manufacturer's operating instructions.
* Use products only for their intended purposes.
* Arrange professional installation where required.
* Carry out appropriate maintenance.
* Stop using products that appear unsafe.
* Retain relevant purchase and installation documentation.
* Contact us when a product issue arises.
These recommendations do not remove statutory rights or impose additional legal conditions on customers.
16. How Long Does a Warranty Claim Take?
The time required to resolve a warranty enquiry depends on the product, nature of the fault, availability of replacement parts, and whether a technical assessment is necessary.
We aim to review enquiries promptly and communicate the next steps.
Where a statutory repair or replacement is required, we will comply with the obligation to provide the remedy within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience.
If a refund is due, it will be processed within the applicable statutory deadline.
17. Contact Our Product Support Team
If you need assistance with a warranty claim, product defect, repair, or replacement, please contact us.
The Handle Factory
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
Please contact us before sending a product to our business address. We will confirm the appropriate return or inspection arrangements.
18. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Warranty & Product Support Policy to reflect changes in our product range, manufacturer warranty arrangements, customer service procedures, or applicable legislation.
Updates will be published on this page with a revised effective date.
Changes will not retrospectively remove statutory rights or commercial warranty commitments applicable to purchases already made.

lines: Order Help Centre
Welcome to the The Handle Factory Order Help Centre.
At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we're committed to making your shopping experience simple, secure, and convenient.
Whether you need help placing an order, tracking a delivery, updating your order details, requesting a cancellation, or arranging a return, our customer support team is here to assist you.
1. How Can We Help You?
Our Order Help Centre provides assistance with:
* Placing an order
* Order confirmation and payment enquiries
* Order status and tracking
* Shipping and delivery
* Changing or cancelling an order
* Returns, refunds, and exchanges
* Damaged, defective, or incorrect products
* Warranty and product support
If you need personalised assistance, contact us at info@thehandlefactory.uk.
2. Placing an Order
How do I place an order?
Shopping at The Handle Factory is straightforward.
1. Visit https://thehandlefactory.uk.
2. Browse our product categories.
3. Select the product you wish to purchase.
4. Review its specifications, price, and availability.
5. Add the item to your basket.
6. Proceed to checkout.
7. Enter your billing and delivery information.
8. Select an available payment method.
9. Review your order and complete your purchase.
Once your order has been successfully placed, an order confirmation will be sent to the email address provided during checkout.
What products can I order?
We offer products across the following categories:
* Wood Stove Accessories
* Fireplaces
* Generators
* Water Heaters
* Saunas
* Furnaces & Boilers
Product specifications, available options, and pricing are displayed on individual product pages.
3. Order Confirmation
How will I know if my order was successful?
After completing checkout, you should receive an order confirmation email containing:
* Your order number
* Purchased products
* Order total in GBP (£)
* Billing information
* Delivery address
* Payment confirmation details
Please keep your order number for future reference.
I haven't received my confirmation email. What should I do?
If you haven't received your confirmation email:
1. Check your spam or junk folder.
2. Confirm that you entered the correct email address.
3. Check whether your payment was completed.
4. Contact our support team if you still cannot locate the confirmation.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Please avoid placing a duplicate order until you have confirmed the status of your original purchase.
4. Order Processing
How long does it take to process an order?
Our standard order handling time is 3 business days.
Orders are processed Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.
Order Cut-Off Time: 12:00 AM (midnight), GMT.
Orders placed outside the applicable processing cycle are handled during the next eligible business-day cycle.
What does "Processing" mean?
An order marked as processing generally means that payment has been received and the order is being prepared for dispatch.
During this stage, we may be verifying order details, preparing the product, or arranging shipment.
What does "Completed" mean?
An order marked as completed generally means that the order has been fulfilled in our system.
Depending on the order management system, this status may not necessarily mean that the carrier has delivered the parcel.
Please refer to your shipment tracking information for delivery updates.
5. Shipping & Delivery Assistance
Do you offer free shipping?
Yes. We offer free standard shipping on all eligible orders throughout the United Kingdom.
* Shipping Cost: £0.00
* Minimum Order Value: None
* Delivery Destination: Customer's address
How long does delivery take?
Our estimated delivery timeframe is 5–7 business days.
Delivery Stage
Estimated Time
Order Handling
3 business days
Shipping Transit
2–4 business days
Total Estimated Delivery
5–7 business days
Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding applicable public holidays.
Delivery estimates are not guaranteed arrival dates.
How can I track my order?
Once tracking information is available, you can follow the tracking details provided in your shipping confirmation.
You can also visit our Track Your Order page.
If you need assistance, email info@thehandlefactory.uk with your order number.
My order is delayed. What should I do?
If your order has not arrived within the estimated delivery period:
1. Check your latest tracking information.
2. Review any carrier notifications.
3. Contact our support team with your order number.
We will investigate the shipment and provide available updates.
Your statutory delivery rights remain unaffected.
6. Changing an Order
Can I change my delivery address?
If your order has not yet been dispatched, we may be able to update your delivery address.
Contact us as soon as possible at info@thehandlefactory.uk.
Please provide:
* Your order number
* Your full name
* Your current delivery address
* Your requested new delivery address
Once the order has been dispatched, address changes may not be possible.
Can I change the product I ordered?
If you selected the wrong product, size, model, or variation, contact us promptly.
We will review whether the order can be amended before dispatch.
If a change is not possible, cancellation and a new order may be required.
7. Order Cancellation
Can I cancel my order?
Yes. You can request cancellation by contacting our customer support team.
Email: info@thehandlefactory.uk
Please include your order number and a clear cancellation request.
We aim to accommodate cancellations before dispatch.
If your order has already been dispatched, applicable statutory cancellation rights and our voluntary return policy may still apply.
Are there cancellation fees?
No. We do not charge order cancellation fees for eligible cancellations.
For complete information, please review our Order Cancellation Policy.
8. Returns & Refunds
What is your return policy?
We offer a 30-day return window for eligible products.
Our standard return arrangements include:
* Returns accepted for defective and non-defective products
* Exchanges accepted
* New-condition requirement for standard non-defective returns
* Returns by post
* Free prepaid return label included in the package
* No restocking fees
* Refund processing target within 10 days
Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.
How do I request a return?
To request a return:
1. Email info@thehandlefactory.uk.
2. Include your order number.
3. Explain the reason for your return.
4. Follow the return instructions provided by our team.
5. Use the free prepaid return label included in your package.
For large or heavy products, contact us before arranging transport.
How long does a refund take?
Our standard refund processing target is within 10 calendar days after receiving and assessing the return, where applicable.
We will comply with any earlier or otherwise applicable statutory refund deadlines.
Refunds are generally issued to the original payment method.
Can I exchange a product?
Yes. We accept exchanges for eligible products.
Contact us with your order number and the details of the requested exchange.
Exchanges are subject to product availability and applicable consumer rights.
9. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Orders
My product arrived damaged. What should I do?
If your order arrives damaged, please contact our customer support team.
Provide:
* Order number
* Product name
* Description of the damage
* Photographs, if available
We will review the issue and arrange an appropriate resolution in accordance with applicable UK consumer law.
I received the wrong product. What should I do?
If you receive an incorrect item, contact info@thehandlefactory.uk.
Please provide your order number and a description of the item received.
We will investigate and arrange an appropriate remedy.
My order is missing an item. What should I do?
Some orders may be delivered in separate packages.
Check your shipping confirmation and tracking information for additional shipments.
If you believe an item is missing, contact our support team with your order number and the missing product details.
10. Warranty & Product Support
Do your products come with a warranty?
Warranty coverage depends on the product and manufacturer.
Where applicable, warranty information will be provided in the product listing or accompanying documentation.
Your statutory consumer rights apply independently of any manufacturer's warranty.
What if my product develops a fault?
If your product develops a fault, please contact us with:
* Order number
* Product name and model
* Description of the issue
* Relevant photographs, if available
We will review the issue and advise you on the appropriate next steps.
Do you provide installation services?
Installation is not included in standard product delivery unless explicitly stated in the relevant product listing or agreed separately.

Products involving gas, electrical systems, combustion appliances, or other safety-critical installations should be installed by appropriately qualified professionals in accordance with applicable UK regulations.
11. Payment Assistance
What currency do you accept?
All prices are displayed in British Pounds Sterling (GBP, £).
What payment methods are available?
The payment methods accepted for your purchase will be displayed at checkout.
For further information, visit our Payment Methods page.
My payment failed. What should I do?
If your payment is unsuccessful:
1. Check that your payment details are correct.
2. Confirm that your payment method has sufficient available funds.
3. Check whether your bank requires additional authorisation.
4. Try another available payment method if appropriate.
5. Contact customer support if the problem continues.
Please do not email full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.
12. Frequently Requested Assistance
I entered the wrong email address.
Contact us with your order number and correct email address so we can review your request.
My tracking information has not updated.
Carrier tracking updates may take time to appear. If tracking remains unchanged or the estimated delivery period has passed, please contact us.
I need a copy of my order confirmation.
Contact our support team with your order number and the email address used at checkout.
I want to return a large appliance.
Contact us before arranging transportation. We will provide appropriate return instructions and help coordinate a suitable return method.
I need help choosing a compatible accessory.
Provide the product brand, model number, and relevant specifications. Our team can assist with available product information.
13. Contact Our Customer Support Team
If you need assistance with your order, our customer support team is available through the following contact details.
The Handle Factory

Website: https://thehandlefactory.uk
Business Address:
Studio 210, 134–136 Curtain Road
London, England EC2A 3AR
United Kingdom
For faster assistance, please include your order number and a clear description of your enquiry.
